Provider excerpts captured November 1, 2026, approximately 22:50-22:53 UTC.
JSON lists were shortened to one station / two forecast or detail records;
XML was reduced to one station and two forecast points. Values were not changed.
The full byte-for-byte responses remain in the private research archive.

Sources: XML `type=obs` and `type=forec`, and Gottvedur `observations/latest`,
`observations/detailsByHour`, `observations/observationStations`,
`forecasts/highChart`, and `forecasts/forecastStations`.
These fixtures describe response shapes, not guaranteed measurement semantics.
Weather data originates from the Icelandic Met Office; this project is unofficial.
